tag_rationale: After Rule 43: 2024_general UNDETERMINED, 2026_primary UNDETERMINED, 2026_runoff LATER. Exactly one election is determined, so the tag is COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS with low confidence.

2024_general.fact: The Elections page groups files without election labels for older entries; no file clearly tied to the Nov 5, 2024 general election was identified within budget. Check 3 pending.

2026_primary.fact: Rule 43: no election-night file survives (earliest time 2026-03-06 16:22 CT). Previous: 'Unofficial Results' for the primary (image3029.pdf) is a scanned Hart 'Cumulative Results Report DICKENS COUNTY, TEXAS PRIMARY ELECTION 3/3/2026 Unofficial Results' (county totals), 'Run Time 3:18 PM Run Date 03/05/2026', Last-Modified Fri, 06 Mar 2026 22:22:17 GMT. Precinct numbers appear only in the later 'Official Republican Precinct Results' and 'Official Democratic Precinct Results' files. Nothing with precinct numbers dates from election night.

2026_runoff.fact: On runoff night the county uploaded 'Primary Runoff Election 5/26/2026 Unofficial Results' (image3863.pdf, Last-Modified Wed, 27 May 2026 01:40:59 GMT, 8:40 PM CDT), which is only the 'Preliminary Election Reconciliation - Unofficial Totals' form (ballot counts, no candidate votes). The 'Precinct Results Report for Primary Runoff' (image3884.pdf) is a scanned Hart 'Precinct Results Report ... PRIMARY RUNOFF ELECTION 5/26/2026 Official Results', 'Run Time 9:44 AM Run Date 06/01/2026', Last-Modified Wed, 03 Jun 2026 14:57:58 GMT. Rule 43: county totals first seen 2026-05-26 20:40 CT in image3863.pdf, linked as 'Primary Runoff Election 5/26/2026 Unofficial Results', a 'Preliminary Election Reconciliation - Unofficial Totals' form (county-level ballot totals, no candidate or precinct votes), Last-Modified Wed, 27 May 2026 01:40:59 GMT (8:40 PM CDT).
